26.text: Painting with the blood of the sacrifice is symbolical of the membership of

27.text: all members of the family in the same hearth. For this reason it is an essential

28.text: part of the marriage ceremony. A fawn is killed as usual; and the bridal pair,

29.text: with at least one female member of the family, perform the ceremony of

30.text: painting. The woman paints the bride and groom, and then she is painted

31.text: by the groom. The same ceremony is gone through in the case of adoption.
